roleHeadline.en: Backend Engineer with 7+ years of experience specializing in distributed systems, event-driven architecture, and high-throughput API integrations.
roleHeadline.id: Backend Engineer berpengalaman 7+ tahun dengan spesialisasi sistem terdistribusi, arsitektur event-driven, dan integrasi API berkinerja tinggi.

summary.en: Senior Backend & Site Reliability Engineer with 7+ years of hands-on experience designing, scaling, and operating distributed systems across core SaaS platforms and dedicated enterprise on-premise deployments (Danone, MyPertamina, BCA Syariah, Adira Finance). Proven track record owning complex initiatives end-to-end: engineered autonomous AI-driven incident triage bots (SRE Assistant) in Lark, shipped rapid production hotfixes resolving critical race conditions, re-architected legacy authentication into Go within 1 month, maintained high-throughput background worker monorepos, and built real-time CDC aggregation pipelines with Debezium and Kafka.
summary.id: Senior Backend & Site Reliability Engineer dengan 7+ tahun pengalaman merancang, mengembangkan, dan mengoperasikan sistem terdistribusi pada platform inti SaaS serta instalasi enterprise on-premise (Danone, MyPertamina, BCA Syariah, Adira Finance). Terbukti mengeksekusi inisiatif teknis kompleks secara end-to-end: membangun bot triage insiden otonom berbasis AI (SRE Assistant) di Lark, merilis hotfix produksi cepat untuk mengatasi race condition kritis, merancang ulang layanan autentikasi ke Go dalam 1 bulan, mengelola monorepo worker asinkron, dan membangun pipeline agregasi CDC real-time berbasis Debezium dan Kafka.
